verdict.rationale: Bruno supports environment switching (an environment selector dropdown, plus a CLI flag to override environment variables at runtime) and can serve mock responses, so tests can target a non-production or mocked backend. The evidence for this is thin: one-line docs and release notes. Safe Mode only sandboxes script execution, not data. missing for 10: documented per-environment sandbox/staging targeting workflow, guardrails preventing accidental production calls, in-depth mock server documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
